content.text: Shift middleware fixed the clipped tooltip on the rightmost bar—continuing with usage chart next.

Dashboard chart tooltips still mount a one-off positioning helper that diverges from the shared floating primitives used by the rest of the app. Arrow placement and collision behavior disagree with design system defaults, and the helper breaks under strict mode double-mount.

Complete when all chart tooltip surfaces (velocity, burndown, distribution, usage) use the shared portal plus offset middleware, visual regression screenshots update, and the legacy tooltip position utility is deleted from the dashboard package with no remaining imports.

description_text:
Dashboard chart tooltips still mount a one-off positioning helper that diverges from the shared floating primitives used by the rest of the app. Arrow placement and collision behavior disagree with design system defaults, and the helper breaks under strict mode double-mount.
Complete when all chart tooltip surfaces (velocity, burndown, distribution, usage) use the shared portal plus offset middleware, visual regression screenshots update, and the legacy tooltip position utility is deleted from the dashboard package with no remaining imports.
